meta_description: 4,256 likes, 49 comments - chrisburkard on October 26, 2026: "We got totally fogged out deep in Iceland's Westfjords during a sailing photography workshop. Land was barely visible and, without even a breath of wind coming through, hopes for clear sky were far off. The only thing left to do was pull out the SUP, paddle across the eerily still water, and capture this surreal moment of stillness.".
